steps.title: Collect saliva samples
steps.instruction: Collect saliva from each participant on Day 1 and after the 24th session between 10:00 am and 11:00 am, instructing them to avoid brushing teeth, using salivary stimulants, and eating a main meal within 1 hour before collection, and to avoid acidic or sugary foods within 20 minutes before collection.

steps.title: Centrifuge and aliquot saliva
steps.instruction: Centrifuge each saliva sample for 10 minutes at 1,000 × g in a refrigerated centrifuge, transfer 300 µL of supernatant into a 1.5 mL microtube, and store the aliquot at ≤ ‑80 °C until assay.

steps.title: Prepare ELISA kit and plates
steps.instruction: Gather the DELUXE HUMAN BDNF ELISA kit (BioLegend®) and follow the manufacturer’s instructions. If not all microplate strips will be used, press up the unused strips from underneath each strip and return them to the foil pouch.

steps.title: Prepare standard series
steps.instruction: Prepare 1 000 µL of a 10 000 pg/mL top standard by mixing 50 µL of the standard stock with 950 µL of Assay Buffer A. Perform six two‑fold serial dilutions in separate tubes using Assay Buffer A to obtain standards of 10 000, 5 000, 2 500, 1 250, 625, 312.5, and 156.3 pg/mL.

steps.title: Initial plate wash
steps.instruction: Wash the ELISA plate four times with 300 µL of 1X Wash Buffer per well. After each wash, blot residual buffer by firmly tapping the plate upside‑down on a clean, absorbent surface.

steps.title: Add assay diluent C to standard wells
steps.instruction: Add 50 µL of Assay Diluent C to each well that will receive a standard.

steps.title: Add standards and samples
steps.instruction: Add 50 µL of each standard dilution or each saliva sample (run in duplicate or triplicate) to the appropriate wells.

steps.title: First incubation
steps.instruction: Seal the plate with the provided Plate Sealer and incubate the plate for the time specified in the kit manual (duration not stated in the text).

steps.title: Second plate wash
steps.instruction: Discard the plate contents into a sink and wash the plate four times with 300 µL of 1X Wash Buffer per well, blotting as before.

steps.title: Add detection antibody
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL of Human BDNF Detection Antibody solution to each well, seal the plate, and incubate for the time indicated in the kit manual.

steps.title: Third plate wash
steps.instruction: Discard the plate contents into a sink and wash the plate four times with 300 µL of 1X Wash Buffer per well, blotting as before.

steps.title: Add Avidin‑HRP
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL of Avidin‑HRP solution to each well, seal the plate, and incubate for the time specified by the kit.

steps.title: Final washes
steps.instruction: Discard the plate contents into a sink and wash the plate five times with 300 µL of 1X Wash Buffer per well. For the final wash, soak each well in Wash Buffer for 30 seconds to 1 minute before blotting.

steps.title: Add substrate and develop
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL of Substrate Solution F to each well and incubate at room temperature for 15–20 minutes in the dark. Do not seal the plate during this step; wells containing BDNF will turn blue with intensity proportional to concentration.

steps.title: Stop reaction
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL of Stop Solution to each well to halt the enzymatic reaction.

steps.title: Read absorbance
steps.instruction: Immediately read the plate at 450 nm. If the plate reader can also measure at 570 nm, record the 570 nm absorbance and subtract it from the 450 nm value. After adding Stop Solution, the protocol mentions incubating the plate at room temperature for 1 hour with shaking before reading; perform this step if required by your reader.
